intro.heading: A few questions so I can build your tool around how you actually work.
intro.hint: About 15 minutes. One question at a time. Skip anything you don't know, and stop anytime. Your answers stay on this phone until you send them.
intro.tip: Tip: tap the mic on your keyboard and just talk.

questions.question: In one sentence, how do you describe what you do to someone you just met?
Which services do you want more of?
questions.hint: The one or two jobs you'd love to do more.

questions.question: What's your best type of job?
questions.hint: The one you'd take every single time.

questions.question: What towns or counties do you work in?
What's your best line?
questions.hint: The one that makes someone say "I need that guy."

questions.question: Who sends you work today?
Which groups are you in, and how often do they meet?
Name your top 5 referral sources right now.
questions.hint: One line on each is plenty.

questions.question: Who should be sending you work but isn't?
Should your subs be in this tool?
How many people are real referral relationships for you?
After you meet someone new, what actually happens next?
How often should you touch base with a solid referral partner?
How do you like to reach out?
Who have you sent work to lately?
questions.hint: Giving back matters. The tool will remind you of that too.

questions.question: About how many customers have you done work for in the last three years?
What's your office CRM called, and can the office export a list from it?
questions.hint: Name, phone, email, type of job, and date is all I need.

questions.question: Should the tool remind you to personally check in with past customers?
options: Yes, but loop in the office

questions.question: About 30% of your work comes from past customers. What's a good number a year from now?
When would you actually look at a daily list?
Realistically, how many people a day can you reach out to?
Do you use Gmail and Google Calendar for work?
Will anyone else use this?
questions.hint: Reed, someone in the office? Who should see what?

questions.question: Are you getting the Plaud?
Paste 3 to 5 real texts you've sent to a referral partner or past customer.
questions.hint: Copy them straight from your phone. Don't clean them up. This is how the drafts end up sounding like you.

questions.question: Any words or phrases you'd never say?
Anything the tool should never do on its own?
questions.hint: Nothing goes out unless you tap send. That's the default.

questions.question: 90 days from now, what would make this worth it?
Anything else I should know?
